fields.statement: Detached checkout at 22f10f8db. The acceptance grep over status.go, inbox.go, proposals.go and daemon_fold.go printed nothing; the IndexPath grep over render.go printed nothing and grep -c FoldLog render.go printed 1 (the !HoldsLog fallback). go vet ./internal/api exit 0. go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/api -run '^(TestStatus|TestInbox|TestUncoveredProposals|TestDaemonPlansProposalsPending|TestDaemonIdlePollSkipsFold|TestDaemonPollCacheInvalidates|TestDaemonFoldIndexedMatchesLog|TestRender|TestPropertyProjectionParity)' ok, including TestRenderIndexedAfterInPlaceEdit (the in-place edit failure case) and the parity test. go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(status|inbox-|render|daemon-plans-proposals)' ok with RHIZA_/SHIP_/REX_ vars unset. Diff read: only the five named files change in code; the log-fold branches are removed rather than left as fallbacks, the projection is never nil (useProjection opens a throwaway index when IndexPath is empty, a failedProjection on error), no --json shape or rendered file changes, no stubs or TODOs.
